key_concepts: Matter can be classified as a pure substance or a mixture.
Pure substances have definite, uniform composition and identical intensive properties.
Pure substances include elements and compounds.
Elements cannot be broken down into simpler substances by chemical means.
Mixtures are made of two or more substances with variable composition.
A chemical formula shows the symbols and exact number of atoms in a substance.
Chemical formulas help distinguish pure substances from mixtures.
Common names, chemical names, and formulas identify household substances such as baking so
Buffer systems regulate the pH of biological fluids like blood.
Blood pH is normally about 7.35; acidosis and alkalosis result from abnormal pH.
